page.overview:
Who is Iyashi?

He wears the standard high-collared, full body uniform of the Konoha medical ninja. His uniform has also the Konoha Medic Corps emblem on the left side of his chest.

As a medical-nin, Iyashi presumably has a high level of intellect, is well-versed in medical ninjutsu, and has excellent chakra control to perform medical procedures. In the anime, he is able to perform the Mystical Palm Technique.

Following Sasuke Uchiha's match in the preliminary rounds of the Chūnin Exams, Iyashi tried to take him away to deal with his injuries, but Kakashi Hatake volunteered to do it instead.

In the anime, Iyashi along with Mitate, Mogusa, Kusushi, and a few other medical-nin were deployed from the hospital to save Asuma Sarutobi, Kurenai Yūhi, and the others after their encounter with Mizuki. They were able to give them first aid on the stop and then later relocated them to the hospital to recover.
